newsitem.title: USA: Moto Photo sees 1997 EPS in upper range.
newsitem.headline: Moto Photo sees 1997 EPS in upper range.

text.p: Moto Photo Inc said Monday that it expects to post earnings per share in the "upper end" of a range between $0.15 and $20.0 per share for the 1997 fiscal year.
Chairman and Chief Executive Michael Adler said in a statement that he also anticipates "continued quarterly earnings growth in the third and fourth quarter" of 1997.
"However, the third quarter growth in earnings will be modest because of last year's third quarter one time gain from the sale of a store lease amounting to approximately $0.04 per share," he said.
Moto Photo is a franchisor and operator of 434 one-hour photofinishing labs and portrait studios in the United States, Canada and Norway.

In the second quarter ended June 30, the company reported net income of $528,590, or $0.06 per share, on revenues of $10.99 million. In the prior year's second quarter, the company posted net income of $309,356, or $0.03 per share, on revenues of $10.79 million.
